caption: The drawing depicts an indoor scene of a church altar with detailed architectural and decorative elements. In the center, there is a statue of a woman in a blue robe, standing in a niche with a radiating golden halo behind her head, elevated on a platform with three green and brown steps. The altar in front of the statue is covered with a white cloth that has a lace edge and features a gold-framed panel with a cross inside a circle. On the altar are six candlesticks with white candles, three on each side. Flanking the central statue are two arched wall niches, each containing a statue of a person in brown robes with additional small candleholders on the edges of each niche. Floral and geometric patterns, rendered in pastel colors such as peach, blue, green, and gold, decorate the walls, columns, and ceiling beams, with recurring motif borders along the upper edges. On the left and right sides of the scene, there are two arched doorways, the left one with a closed white double door and the right one open, both surrounded by yellow borders. The floor is brown with wood grain, and the lower sections of the walls are shaded blue, separated by a gold trim. The composition is symmetrical, with the focus on the central altar and statue.
title: La Purisima Mission - Restored in 1941
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
